evidence_provenance.role_in_policy_derivation: G.D4 reconciliation audit report with score-level mechanism evidence
Nine-row ET canonical mismatch matrix with current approval flags

transactional_publication_ready_meaning: All temporary-file validation, JSON/Markdown consistency checks, and synthetic partial-replacement rollback tests passed before the real report publication attempt.

A_evidence_completeness.description: Mismatch exists in both deterministic builds with complete evidence.

B_exact_deterministic_equality.description: Build 1 and Build 2 mismatch values and artifacts are exactly equal.

C_et_mechanism.description: Row is ET-derived through direct model, selected candidate, or soft ensemble.

D_accepted_output_comparison.description: Candidate-level non-ET byte equality, ET build byte equality, and four independent ET score-delta fields.

E_metric_classification.description: Metric must be on the exact allowlist.

F_metric_delta.description: Absolute metric delta from canonical must be within tolerance.

G_validation_and_categorical_invariants.description: Validation reconstructions exact with unchanged categorical identity.

H_fail_closed.description: Any missing, null, NaN, or disagreement rejects eligibility.

concept_separation.mechanistically_eligible_under_frozen_po: Predicate et_rank_metric_reconciliation_eligible returns true; does not change approval status.
concept_separation.currently_approved_exception: Historical approval recorded in mismatch matrix; unchanged by G.D5.
concept_separation.currently_unapproved_mismatch: Rows not currently approved; remain unapproved after G.D5.
